title: Marriage Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board

scheme.name: Marriage Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
scheme.summary: Financial assistance is provided to female workers in Gujarat after their marriage.
eligibility: Only female workers working in a factory/organization in the state of Gujarat whose Labour Welfare Fund is paid by the organization at the office are eligible.
The Labour Welfare Fund for the last one year of the woman worker must be mandatorily filled by the Factory/Company/Organization.
Application should be made within one year from the date of marriage.
There must be a gap of one year between the date of employment and the date of marriage of the woman worker.
scheme.benefits: Female workers are entitled to receive ₹11,000/- after their marriage.
documents: A copy of the identity card issued by the contractor to the worker/labour
scheme.how_to_apply: Applicants can apply online by visiting the Sanman Portal, registering under Citizen Login using Aadhaar Card and Labour Welfare Fund Account details, selecting the scheme, filling out the application form, uploading documents, and submitting.
